title: 你身体里的一秒钟 / One Second Inside You

reference_clip.subject: Mitochondrial ATP synthase molecular turbines driven by luminous proton streams in warm glowing microscopic environment
hud_elements: Bottom-left scale hierarchy (人体 Body -> 器官 Organ -> 细胞 Cell -> 分子 Molecule -> 原子 Atom) with nanometer ruler
Right-side '这一秒 / IN THIS SECOND' 8-metric live tally card with rapidly climbing ATP battery counter
Left contextual callouts ('真实速度 每秒 100+ 圈 / 画面速度 每秒约 1 圈', '转子：被质子推着转 / Rotor: pushed by a flow of protons')

acts.name: Real-time one-second stopwatch
acts.key_visuals: Main title '你身体里的一秒钟 / One Second Inside You', central circular stopwatch sweeping 0.000 -> 1.000 in real time.

acts.name: Time slowdown and cosmic HUD initialization
acts.key_visuals: 120x time slowdown cue; cosmic dark HUD initializes around standing translucent 3D human silhouette with top-right ECG monitor and right-hand '这一秒 / IN THIS SECOND' card.

acts.name: Full-body nerve transmission and heart ventricle contraction
acts.key_visuals: Neural signal flashes along peripheral nerves (~100 m/s), camera zooms smoothly into contracting 3D heart pumping blood.

acts.name: Capillary flow, red blood cells and muscle cell mitochondria dive
acts.key_visuals: Macro zoom into narrow capillaries with tumbling red blood cells releasing oxygen across muscle membrane into glowing mitochondria.

acts.name: Mitochondrial ATP synthase turbines (Reference Keyclip Segment)
acts.key_visuals: Seamless entry into warm luminous mitochondrial interior matching input/keyclip.mp4: 3D molecular ATP synthase turbines spinning on central stalks pushed by glowing protons, energy glow flashes, bilingual subtitles, trillions ATP tally climbing.

acts.name: Membrane ion channel gates locked to ECG electrical spike
acts.key_visuals: Zoom into adjacent phospholipid bilayer with closed ion-channel gates and crowded outside sodium ions; top-right ECG spikes and triggers visible closed -> open gate transition + bright millisecond ion torrent.

acts.name: Swift reverse zoom back to human silhouette
acts.key_visuals: Rapid multi-scale reverse camera zoom ascending through all anatomical layers back to the full standing translucent human figure.

acts.name: 1.000 s halt and 8-metric summary dashboard
acts.key_visuals: Micro-timer stops cleanly at 1.000 s; right-side dashboard displays all 8 physiological achievements simultaneously.

acts.name: Final conclusion and closing title card
acts.key_visuals: Settling heartbeat glow and closing bilingual statement '你什么都没做，可你的身体，把这些事全做完了'.
